|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip that prints it. The current text is [[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. The PC card image ([[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]], PC-E2) and the Master List both print this text again word for word.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may ▲ one Trample or Walker Barrage. Walker Barrage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 6, slip 81. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-81-Blizzard_2.png]]) prints slip number “81” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “Walker Barage total” for “Walker Barrage total” (typo as published) (it writes ▲ out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only): “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may take one Trample or Walker Barrage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Walker Barage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="cl-1220_81-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-blizzard2-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual2-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/blizzard2.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034549/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual2-Dark], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock2-Dark/large/blizzard2.gif</ref>: “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may ▲ one Trample or Walker Barrage. Walker Barrage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 2 set mark) and prints the number “81” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 56), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=56, page 56. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=56 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may ▲ one Trample or Walker Barrage. Walker Barrage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1220-81-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
